thread.title: Bosqueville books first trip to state championship since 2008 - NewsBreak
thread.title_full: Bosqueville books first trip to state championship since 2008 - NewsBreak

author: Parker Rehm
title: Bosqueville books first trip to state championship since 2008 - NewsBreak
text:
By Parker Rehm ,
1 hours ago STEPHENVILLE, Texas ( FOX 44 ) — The Lady Bulldogs are partying like it’s 2008 after sweeping Wednesday’s state semifinal doubleheader to punch their ticket to the 2A Division I state championship game, 4-3, 10-3 over Cisco on Wednesday night.
Cisco took a 3-1 lead into the fifth inning before the Lady Bulldogs answered in a big way. Tagen Huffhines blasted a two-run bomb to tie the ballgame at three, paving the way for some late inning heroics.
Landrie Willie walked it off in the bottom of the seventh with a RBI double to the wall to bring in Magnolia Donaldson to take game one, 4-3.
In game two, the Lady Bulldogs took a while to get started but there was no stopping Bosqueville when the bats got going.
The Lady Bulldogs jumped out to a 2-0 lead in the fourth on a two-RBI double from Deja Torres and added on in the next inning with two runs to make it 4-1.
Back-to-back sixth inning bombs from Presley Eubank and Magnolia Donaldson extended the lead to 7-1, never looking back to clinch a state championship appearance.
The Lady Bulldogs will play for the first ever 2A State Championship on Thursday, May 28th at 10:00 a.m. in Austin.
